tagline: Scales, chords, fifths, a quiz — offline, in this file.
description:
Practice scales, triads, sevenths, and the circle of fifths on a two-octave keyboard. There is no account and nothing to install: this copy is the app, and your quiz score and finished rounds stay in the file.

Tap the keys on a phone, or use the home row (A to quote). A MIDI keyboard is optional. Hard mode hides the next note. Shuffle starts each round on a new degree. Hear plays the notes you are about to find.

The quiz asks which fifth, the key signature, the name of a chord, or to play a named note — tap an answer, no MIDI required.

Press Practice together, then Invite in the bar above, and a friend sees the same prompt.

An unofficial port of Piano Trainer by Zane Helton. The original is a React desktop app that loads a soundfont from the network. This copy keeps the piano inside the file.
